cards.name: Receding-Horizon GAN Consensus for DT
cards.observed_failure: DT locally helps at 3k/H200 but decays by H1000 and becomes harmful at 4k
cards.unsb_object: full optimizer-state transition under the native GAN component
cards.derivation: From the same immutable full state S_k, compute B0=Phi_0^8(S_k) and Bi=Phi_dt^8(S_k). Let Delta=G_GAN(Bi)-G_GAN(B0). Commit Bi iff Delta<0; otherwise commit B0.
cards.identity_condition: Delta_G_GAN >= 0 commits the exact plain branch
cards.self_null_condition: a rejected proposal contributes zero parameters, moments, schedulers, streams or RNG state
cards.paired_target_proof: the decision reads only branch-averaged unpaired G_GAN; PSNR/SSIM/LPIPS and confirmation identities are absent from the controller interface
cards.expected_valid_states: states whose 8-step observable retains its audited lead relationship
cards.falsification_test: proposal-only, observable-only/plain, and full selector from the same e0; kill if the selector chooses harmful H200 branches or fails the 2400-step late gate
cards.compute_cost: two 8-update branches per committed 8 updates; proposal branch inherits parent-probe cost
cards.memory_cost: one live branch at a time plus one CPU full-state snapshot
pseudocode: commit proposal if direction * (mean(G_GAN)_proposal - mean(G_GAN)_plain) > 0 else plain

cards.observed_failure: HJ's own gate/risk cannot distinguish beneficial and harmful states
